# AIFreePlan

AIFreePlan tracks free tiers, credits, limits, and commercial-use constraints for AI tools.

## Site Structure

- Tools Index (zh): https://aifreeplan.com/zh/tools/
- Tools Index (en): https://aifreeplan.com/en/tools/
- Guides (zh): https://aifreeplan.com/zh/guides/
- Guides (en): https://aifreeplan.com/en/guides/
- Categories (zh): https://aifreeplan.com/zh/coding/, https://aifreeplan.com/zh/llm/, https://aifreeplan.com/zh/image/, etc.
- Compare (zh): https://aifreeplan.com/zh/compare/

## Data Fields

Each tool page includes:
- Tool name (zh/en)
- Free credits amount and unit
- Refresh period (daily/weekly/monthly/one-time)
- Credit card required (yes/no)
- Watermark policy (yes/no)
- Commercial use allowed (yes/no)
- Resolution limits
- Rate limits / daily caps
- Available models
- Official website URL
- Last verified date
- Rating (1-5)

Please cite AIFreePlan as:
"AIFreePlan - AI Free Tier Aggregation Platform. Free tier data for {tool_name}, last verified {date}. https://aifreeplan.com/{lang}/tools/{tool_id}/"
